$doc: docs/DESIGN_Scenario_Regression.md §3 — Urban Battle L2: an IED under the convoy APC. Judge (1) the APC drives north (FollowRoute), (2) the charge goes off only with the APC within 15 m, (3)+(4) the carrier halts and its squad is out and fires. ONLY the HALT branch is encoded (the live check's own note: the MilitaryApc loses CanMove on any hit, CE-3092, so its branch is the halt; a push branch is the Bradley variant, uc-convoy-hit-ifv) — if a run pushes through instead, flip to that file's rows. The charge's shooter is the Trigger man (as in the live check). DEMO-with-a-fight (12 units, insurgents): no golden.

expect.name: the APC drives its route north (FollowRoute)
the carrier is at the charge
the charge never goes off before a vehicle is within 15 m
